witness.note: Iudicium Dei II: Liebermann’s edited Latin text, from the manuscripts he names in Gesetze I, p. 401, note b, listed below
Paris, Bibliothèque nationale de France, MS 943
Pierre Pithou, glossary to the Capitularies (1588), printed
London, British Library, Cotton MS Vitellius A.vii (Vt, the first pontifical)
Cambridge, Corpus Christi College, MS 422, formerly The Rede boke of Derbye
Strood, Medway Archive and Local Studies Centre, MS DRc/R1 (Textus Roffensis; formerly Rochester, Cathedral Library, MS A.3.5)

div.head: Iud Dei II 5
div.ab: His peractis, aqua benedicta cunctis adstantibus detur ad degustandum et aspergatur per totam domum.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 407 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: Folgendes bis Ende (wie Anfang; s. 1ᶜ) England eigen; vgl. II As. 23, 1 (aus niht : noctes 5, 2); Ordal 5, 1 f. 2.
What follows, to the end (like the beginning; see 1ᶜ), is peculiar to England; cf. II As. 23, 1 (from niht : noctes 5, 2); Ordal 5, 1 f. 2.

div.ab: When these things are done, let holy water be given to all those standing by to taste, and let it be sprinkled through the whole house.
